capabilities.name: remote_command_execution
capabilities.evidence: A diagnostic echo command succeeded in an existing Celesto cloud computer.

capabilities.name: persistent_cloud_computer_reuse
capabilities.evidence: The worker reused an existing running computer for diagnostic runs.

capabilities.name: pre_execution_safety_hook
capabilities.evidence: The dangerous command was blocked before the Celesto CLI was called.

capabilities.name: persistent_guest_state_across_stop_start
capabilities.evidence: The guest fixture survived a stop/start cycle. SHA-256: 2bc9c43e0547e59778a9c0ee00afb82f33009ab07b0694657a964282d50c15c6.

capabilities.name: snapshot_creation
capabilities.evidence: Snapshot listing returned no snapshots. Creation failed with a computer-not-found error while computer lookup still showed the computer running. Root cause unknown.

limitations: Snapshot creation and restoration have not been demonstrated.
Network policy enforcement has not been demonstrated.
The safety-hook test uses a mocked CLI and does not establish comprehensive containment.
Fresh-sandbox creation and cleanup have not been verified end to end.
